# `popqc`

Assess population support from existing graph, UMAP, PCA, and precomputed clustering-sweep state

- Wrapper: [`job_population_embedding_qc.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_population_embedding_qc.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.population_embedding_qc`

## Inputs

- population_embedding_qc.input_adata_path (fallback: general.anndata_path)
- Existing UMAP, optional PCA/connectivities, and population or precomputed Leiden obs columns

## Outputs

- outputs/<execution_id>_Population_Embedding_QC/{figures,tables,summaries,files}/
- population_embedding_qc.annotated_adata_path with reusable versioned .uns results only when write_annotated_h5ad is enabled

## Configuration

- general, population_embedding_qc, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl popqc
```
